project_type: React + TypeScript + Vite SPA frontend with Express backend, Clerk authentication, moving to Supabase for data persistence
build_system: npm with tsx for dev server (runs server.ts with Vite middleware), vite build for production
test_framework: None found in package.json - no test suite exists
test_command: npm run lint (TypeScript type checking only via tsc --noEmit)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation passes. Run npm run dev and manually test the application in browser. Check that new users see empty project list with Create Project button, and that project members can only see projects they own or are invited to.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ folder is generated by vite build. Not checked into git.
environment_constraints: Clerk authentication is already integrated via @clerk/clerk-react and @clerk/express. Must not replace Clerk - only add Supabase alongside it. When VITE_SUPABASE_URL or VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are missing, app must gracefully fall back to localStorage so dev still works. server.ts runs on port 3000 by default, uses Vite middleware in dev mode.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Standard Git workflow applies.
key_patterns: All state managed in src/context/ProjectContext.tsx via React Context + localStorage persistence. Types defined in src/types/index.ts. Mock data in src/data/mockData.ts loaded on first run. Tailwind CSS + Lucide icons for UI. Components follow atomic pattern with modals for creation flows. server.ts has mock auth endpoints (/api/auth/*) that will be supplemented with real data endpoints.
directory_structure: src/components/ (all React components), src/context/ (ProjectContext.tsx for state), src/types/ (TypeScript definitions), src/data/ (mockData.ts), src/lib/ (to be created for Supabase client), src/utils/ (to be created for permissions), server.ts (Express backend at root)
